Synopsis:
    Equatorial Guinea police drew firearms on US-deported migrants held at a hotel in Malabo, following a dispute over phone access. 31 deportees remain detained under a Trump-era third-country deportation deal. Rights groups warn of safety risks, legal violations, and opaque bilateral arrangements. The US DHS deflects responsibility once deportees leave ICE custody.
